phases: Contact: the foreground leg crosses in front and trails back to the lower-left boot; the farther leg reaches forward to screen-right.
Down: the foreground leg bends and trails back, its boot lifted slightly; the farther leg supports with its boot flat under the hips. Compact step.
Passing: the foreground knee bends and its lifted boot passes close beside the supporting farther calf. The far boot is flat beneath the body. Arms near vertical.

Reach: foreground leg reaches a little forward to screen-right with boot close to the ground. Farther leg supports nearly vertically. Near arm hangs back beside hip, far arm forward mostly hidden. Low relaxed reach, no high knee.

Opposite contact: the foreground leg runs down-right to the forward boot; the farther leg runs down-left to the trailing boot. Uncrossed inverted-V leg silhouette. Near arm back down at hip, far arm forward mostly hidden.
Opposite down: foreground leg supports, boot flat beneath body, knee softly bent. Farther leg trails with knee bent and heel lifted. Near arm down beside thigh, far arm mostly hidden.
Opposite passing: foreground leg nearly straight supports beneath hips; farther knee bent, lifted boot beside foreground calf, partly hidden behind it. Arms near vertical.

Opposite reach: foreground leg supports near vertically and overlaps the far thigh. Farther leg reaches gently forward; its boot appears just to the right of support boot, slightly above ground. Near arm forward, far arm back. Compact step.

Dark-skinned man with tight short black curls, bright blue denim jacket with back seams and dark cuff buttons, cream tee hem, light gray trousers, white sneakers.
Man with short wavy brown hair, rust-orange sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and waistband, charcoal trousers, brown lace-up shoes.

lastWalkers.description: Dark-skinned woman with thick black rope-twist ponytail tied high with coral hair band, white earbud, coral sleeveless fitted tank, charcoal leggings, white running sneakers with coral heel panels.

Man with tousled brown hair and stubble, rolled-sleeve blue denim jacket with golden stitching and back hem buttons, cream shirt hem, tan trousers, brown shoes, holding a RED leash in his right hand. A small tan-and-white floppy-eared beagle with red collar walks alongside his right, facing away upper-right. Preserve man AND entire dog AND connected leash.
lastWalkers.extra: Keep the entire small beagle at the man's right, same size, same distance and rear orientation, and the red leash connected from right hand to dog's collar. Keep the leash-holding hand near its original position rather than swinging widely. Dog takes a natural four-legged walking step with alternating paws; no sitting, floating or duplicated legs. Keep all paws and tail inside generous transparent margins.

lastWalkers.description: Young woman with long wavy brown hair, silver hoop earring, sage-green and cream wide horizontal striped tee, tan cargo shorts, cream calf socks with two sage stripes, sage sneakers with cream soles and side stripe. Carries black-grip skateboard with natural wood edge and cream wheels beneath right arm.
lastWalkers.extra: Keep skateboard rigid and identical in length, wheel arrangement, grip texture and angle, held tightly under her right arm; keep the right hand and arm anchored to the skateboard and animate only the free left arm plus legs. Never turn the board or add extra wheels.
